name: noir-interrogation
title_zh: 把任何人的思维方式蒸馏成一个能装的 skill
tagline_zh: 面对一个陌生领域的难题，别再瞎猜。把那位专家的脑子拆开，提炼成可复用的决策路径，下次直接调用。
tagline_en: Stop guessing when facing unfamiliar problems. Dissect an expert's mind into a reusable decision path, ready to.
why_zh: 它不存答案，存的是提问顺序和判断阈值。通过结构化访谈，把隐性经验变成显性规则，让 skill 学会在岔。
why_en: It stores not answers but question sequences and judgment thresholds. Structured interviews turn tacit expertise into explicit.
limit_zh: 只适用于能清晰表达自己思考过程的专家；若对方凭直觉行事或不愿复盘，产出将是空壳。访谈需 30 分钟以上。
limit_en: Only works with experts who can articulate their reasoning; intuitive or reluctant subjects yield hollow output. Needs 30+ min interview; quality.
